scientific_integrity: Exact analytic proof supplemented by 294 independent exact-rational generator checks; no independent external validation.
scientific_limitations: Single excitation, three-site chain, equal unit hoppings, site-2-only Markovian dephasing, source at site 1 and loss at site 3; not generalized to larger networks or other noise generators. Broader existing resolvent theory can implicitly cover pointwise formulas; publication-priority comparison remains qualified.
title: Discontinuous-to-continuous onset of noise-assisted absorption in a selectively dephased quantum trimer
